mapper.select:
select * from uav_detect_msg
serial = #{serial} and (dron_lng is not null and dron_lng!=0)
and DATE_FORMAT(data_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{rq}
ORDER BY data_time asc

select *,IF(sd>30,'red',IF(sd>10 and sd<=30,'yellow','green')) as wxdj from uav_detect_msg
serial = #{serial} and (dron_lng is not null and dron_lng!=0)
and DATE_FORMAT(data_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{rq}
ORDER BY data_time desc limit 1

select *, IF(speed>30,'red',IF(speed>10 and speed<=30,'yellow','green')) as wxdj from uav_df_data
( uav_id = #{serial} or REPLACE(uav_id,'RID-','') = #{serial} ) and (longitude is not null and latitude!=0)
and DATE_FORMAT(data_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{rq}
ORDER BY data_time desc limit 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *, ROUND( 6378.138 * 2 * ASIN( SQRT( POW( SIN( ( #{wd} * PI( ) / 180- dron_lat * PI( ) / 180 ) / 2 ), 2 ) + COS( #{wd} * PI( ) / 180 ) * COS( dron_lat * PI( ) / 180 ) * POW( SIN( ( #{jd} * PI( ) / 180- dron_lng * PI( ) / 180 ) / 2 ), 2 ) ) ) ,2) AS jl FROM (select * from uav_detect_msg where serial in( select serial_number from wjbd_wrj_jbxx where auth_status=2 ) union select * from uav_detect_msg where serial not in( select serial_number from wjbd_wrj_jbxx ) ) cc where DATE_FORMAT(data_time, '%Y-%m-%d')=DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d') HAVING (#{jl}/1000) >= jl ) a ORDER BY data_time desc limit 1

SELECT
cache.model AS model,
cache.serial AS serial,
COUNT(DISTINCT cache.alarm_group_id) AS num FROM uav_alarm_group_cache cache
-- 直接过滤中间表的日期，无需计算窗口函数
cache.data_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{nf}, '-', #{yf}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND cache.data_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{nf}, '-', #{yf}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
cache.data_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{nf}, '-01-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND cache.data_time < STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(CAST(#{nf} AS SIGNED) + 1, '-01-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')
AND cache.model IS NOT NULL AND cache.model != ''
AND cache.serial IS NOT NULL AND cache.serial != ''
GROUP BY cache.model
GROUP BY cache.serial
ORDER BY num DESC LIMIT 1000
